title: 第19章 美味灵魂第20章 小诡计的获胜
content_zh:
艾什提起骨索和一人一书摆手，用斗篷后摆遮住魂雾灯的小蓝光，她左手将骨索一端甩在山崖上一颗大树上，右手抡圆骨索不断转圈，当她觉得蓄力足够后，向着山崖下的哨塔尖顶奋力投掷而去。
银色的骨索飞速穿透雨夜，划出一条优美的曲线，随着骨索另一端接触到了哨塔的木尖顶，艾什快速抖动手腕，将骨索一端震动着缠绕在哨塔的木尖顶上，她向后拉了拉骨索，确认绑紧了，便松了口气。
从山崖到北侧的哨塔有二十几米的距离，骨索总共才三十米，能足够距离还是走运的，艾什走到架起一条线的骨索边，蹲下捡起土匪尸体下的斧枪，她拿在手里掂了掂，这武器好像是土匪自己做的，重量配比有些问题。
艾什觉得斧枪上斧头的部分沉重的惊人，她想想还是丢掉了斧枪，土匪的东西就是差劲，帝国的斧枪据说无论是劈砍还是捅刺，都会保持平衡，她只好捡起另一个土匪尸体上的长剑，握在了手里。
艾什左手顺着骨索抖动，将挂在树干上的一端解开，缠绕在自己左手上，她想试试能不能靠着惯力荡到哨塔上，突袭上面的两个土匪，可是她发现骨索过长，荡过去会一头撞上哨塔的梯子，她又只得重新绑上骨索，踩上骨索向哨塔走去。
暴雨的声音盖过了艾什踩在骨索上的哒哒声，那北侧哨塔中的两个土匪还在蜷缩着发抖，抖动着身体取暖，一点没有发觉艾什顺着绳索快速的登上了木质哨塔的顶部。
艾什解开哨塔顶端的骨索，靠手腕和手臂的摆动将缠在树干上的骨索抖散，回收骨索中在骨索即将滑下山崖时，稍微动作大的向上振臂，将骨索抖上天空，最后顺着力道拽回了剩余的骨索。
艾什握住长剑，她听着脚下的动静，那两个土匪没有聊天，只有上下牙打颤的声音，艾什在哨塔顶部爬了下来，上半身探出，靠着小腹和腿部抵住身子，她稳了稳身体，用力倒挂而下，借着力道翻进哨塔内。
两个土匪被突然大头朝下摔进哨塔的东西吓了一跳，两人被吓得一愣，其中一个土匪来不及反应，艾什就已经用长剑刺入了他的眼眶，另一个土匪刚要尖叫，艾什立刻伸出骨索，骨索哗哗地飞出，在土匪的脖子上缠了几圈。
大惊之下的土匪扯起嗓子就要喊，两手抓着脖子上的骨索就要甩下，惊恐的摔坐在了地上。
可艾什的动作更快，她左手臂缠着大多骨索，右手一松放开长剑，抓起绕在土匪脖子上多出来的骨索一端，又绕了两圈把土匪的手和脖子缠在一起，侧着肩膀凶猛的撞击土匪把他撞翻。
土匪躺在地上的同时，艾什的高跟长筒靴就已踩在他的喉咙上，两手大力的向自己扯动，随着艾什的动作，骨索瞬间缠紧，勒紧了土匪的喉咙，消耗着他肺里的空气。
“嘘嘘嘘嘘嘘嘘.....吸气，试着吸气，乖~吸气......”
艾什低沉的声音在雨夜中显得怪异阴森，两手在不断收紧的力道中，土匪被骨索禁锢的手掌手指与脖子，噗嗤噗嗤的被勒出伤口，血液在骨索的压迫中，四下飞溅。
土匪喉咙被自己的手指顶住，他只得呃呃啊啊的挣扎，双腿拼了命的乱蹬，恐惧在他心里蔓延，可这并不能阻止艾什更加用力收紧骨索，很快，土匪的双眼向上翻，舌头吐出老长，挣扎的力道也逐渐减弱。
艾什等着土匪肺中最后一口空气消散，耐着性子感受着骨索于土匪脖子上的震动，直到她感受不到了土匪的心跳，艾什才松开了土匪，两手收着骨索。
“只要细心点.....我能用骨索感受到心跳......操索术真的神奇啊，玩法真多......”
艾什感叹着把收好的骨索别在腰后，她捡起两个哨塔内依靠的木弓，在箭羽尾部缠上骨索一端再打上一个结，她以前从没用过弓箭，不过呢，艾什想要试试看，自己有没有这方面的天赋。
她轻轻将箭矢搭在弓臂上，试着拉动弓弦，不是很难拉动，自己的力气受到安瑟赐福后，似乎也大了不少，她左手稳住木弓，将箭矢箭头对准南侧哨塔上靠着柱子昏昏欲睡的土匪，不由得心想，这么冷的天，他怎么能做到打瞌睡的？
而另一个土匪坐在他身边，背对着土匪望向森林，不知道在想什么，艾什计算着两个哨塔的距离，大概十三四米？艾什有些摸不准，不过只要自己能射中，她就能顺手干掉另一个土匪。

“射中啊......射中啊......安瑟，保佑我......”
艾什低声念叨着，绷紧的弓弦上，箭矢略微随着艾什的动作颤动，艾什仔细的瞄着站着土匪的胸口位置，她屏着呼吸，透过那双玫瑰色的蛇瞳，瞳孔收缩中时，艾什吐出了嘴里的气，右手手指也在此刻松开。
“嗖——————噗！”
箭矢精准的命中了十几米外土匪的胸口，土匪身子一震，两手抓着箭矢愣了下，疼痛紧接着从伤处涌入脑子。
这章没有结束，请点击下一页继续阅读！
“啊啊啊啊啊啊！
！”
土匪在痛叫中，艾什立刻抓着和箭矢射出的骨索，没有拔出土匪身上插着的箭，而是于空中打了个环，向右上方套去。
那坐着的土匪被身后同伴的喊声吓得浑身一震，刚要回头骂身后的家伙，一轮圆环的骨索轻飘飘的落在了他的头上，顺着脑袋滑下，紧接着他感到一股巨大的力量勒住了他的脖子，同时拽着他整个人的身体向北方去。
艾什见套中了土匪，她暗自窃喜，操索术的玩法和创新，简直太多太多了，感谢你保佑我，安瑟，现在，削下来他的脑袋吧.....
骨索骤然绷紧，在艾什右手大力的向下拽下，骨索收紧的如断头台一般，噗嗤一声切断了土匪的脖子，他的头颅从哨塔上转圈掉落在泥土中，发出沉闷的咚声。
“你们叫什么呢！
content_en:
Ash held up the bone rope and the book "One Person, One Person" and waved her hands. She used the back of her cloak to cover the small blue light of the soul fog lamp. She threw one end of the bone rope on a big tree on the cliff with her left hand. She twirled the round bone rope with her right hand and kept spinning. When she felt that she had accumulated enough power, she threw it towards the top of the sentry tower under the cliff.
The silver bone rope quickly penetrated the rainy night, drawing a graceful curve. As the other end of the bone rope touched the wooden spire of the sentry tower, Ash quickly shook her wrist, vibrating one end of the bone rope and wrapped it around the wooden spire of the sentry tower. She pulled the bone rope back to confirm that it was tied tightly, and then breathed a sigh of relief.
There is a distance of more than 20 meters from the cliff to the sentry tower on the north side, and the total distance of the bone rope is only 30 meters. It is lucky that the distance is enough. Ash walked to the bone rope that set up a line, squatted down and picked up the ax gun under the bandit's body. She weighed it in her hand. This weapon seemed to be made by the bandit himself, and there was something wrong with the weight ratio.
Ash felt that the ax head on the ax gun was surprisingly heavy. After thinking about it, she threw away the ax gun. The bandits' tools were inferior. It was said that the empire's ax gun would maintain balance whether it was chopping or stabbing. She had no choice but to pick up the long sword from another bandit's corpse and hold it in her hand.
Ash shook her left hand along the bone rope, untied the end hanging on the tree trunk, and wrapped it around her left hand. She wanted to try if she could rely on inertia to swing to the sentry tower and attack the two bandits above. However, she found that the bone rope was too long and would hit the ladder of the sentry tower when she swung over. She had to tie the bone rope again, stepped on the bone rope and walked towards the sentry tower.
The sound of the heavy rain drowned out the clatter of Ash stepping on the bone rope. The two bandits in the north sentry tower were still huddled and shivering, shaking their bodies to keep warm. They didn't notice that Ash quickly climbed to the top of the wooden sentry tower along the rope.
Ash untied the bone rope at the top of the sentry tower and used the swings of his wrists and arms to shake off the bone rope wrapped around the tree trunk. When recovering the bone rope, when the bone rope was about to slide down the cliff, he raised his arms slightly and shook the bone rope up into the sky. Finally, he used the force to pull back the remaining bone rope.
Ash held the long sword, and she listened to the movement under her feet. The two bandits did not chat, only the chatter of their upper and lower teeth. Ash climbed down on the top of the sentry tower, stretched out her upper body, and leaned on her lower abdomen and legs. She stabilized her body, hung upside down with strength, and used her strength to roll into the sentry tower.
The two bandits were startled by something that suddenly fell headfirst into the sentry tower. One of the bandits had no time to react before Ash stabbed him in the eye with a long sword. Just as the other bandit was about to scream, Ash immediately stretched out the bone rope, which flew out and wrapped around the bandit's neck several times.
The frightened bandit shouted at the top of his lungs, grabbed the bone rope around his neck with both hands and tried to throw it off, and fell to the ground in horror.
But Ash moved faster. Her left arm was wrapped with many bone ropes. She let go of the sword with her right hand, grabbed one end of the extra bone rope around the bandit's neck, circled it twice more, entangled the bandit's hand and neck, and violently hit the bandit with her shoulder, knocking him over.
While the bandit was lying on the ground, Ash's high-heeled boots stepped on his throat, and his hands pulled hard towards him. Following Ash's movements, the bone ropes instantly tightened, tightening the bandit's throat and consuming the air in his lungs.
“Shhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhhh”
Ash's deep voice sounded weird and eerie in the rainy night. As his hands continued to tighten, the bandit's palms, fingers and neck, which were imprisoned by the bone ropes, were cut out. Blood splashed everywhere under the pressure of the bone ropes.
The bandit's throat was pressed against his own fingers, and he had no choice but to struggle, kicking his legs as hard as he could. Fear spread in his heart, but this did not stop Ash from tightening the bone rope even harder. Soon, the bandit's eyes rolled upwards, and his tongue stuck out, struggling with great strength.Tao also gradually weakened.
Ash waited for the last breath of air in the bandit's lungs to dissipate, and patiently felt the vibration of the bone cord on the bandit's neck. It wasn't until she could no longer feel the bandit's heartbeat that Ash let go of the bandit and held the bone cord with both hands.
"As long as you are careful... I can feel the heartbeat with the bone rope... The rope manipulation technique is really amazing, there are so many ways to play..."
Ash sighed and pinned the collected bone rope behind her waist. She picked up the wooden bow that was leaning on the two sentry towers, wrapped one end of the bone rope around the tail of the arrow feathers and tied a knot. She had never used a bow and arrow before, but Ash wanted to try to see if she had any talent in this area.
She gently placed the arrow on the bow arm and tried to pull the bow string. It was not difficult to pull. Her strength seemed to be much stronger after being blessed by Anser. She stabilized the wooden bow with her left hand and pointed the arrow at the sleepy bandit leaning against the pillar on the south sentry tower. She couldn't help but think to herself, how could he doze off in such a cold day?
Another bandit was sitting next to him, with his back to the bandit and looking towards the forest. He didn't know what he was thinking. Ash calculated the distance between the two sentry towers. It was about thirteen or four meters? Ash was a little unsure, but as long as she could shoot, she could easily kill the other bandit.
"Shoot...hit...Ansel, protect me..."
Ash muttered in a low voice. On the taut bow string, the arrow trembled slightly with Ash's movements. Ash carefully aimed at the chest of the standing bandit. She held her breath and looked through the rose-colored snake eyes. When the pupils were contracting, Ash exhaled the breath in her mouth and loosened the fingers of her right hand at this moment.
"Whoosh---poof!"
The arrow accurately hit the bandit's chest more than ten meters away. The bandit's body was shaken, and he was stunned for a moment while holding the arrow with both hands. Pain then poured into his brain from the injured area.

“Ahhhhhhhh!
! "
The bandit was screaming in pain, and Ash immediately grabbed the bone rope that was shot by the arrow. Instead of pulling out the arrow stuck in the bandit's body, he made a loop in the air and pulled it upward to the right.
The sitting bandit was frightened by the shouts of his companions behind him. Just as he was about to turn around and scold the guy behind him, a ring of bone ropes fell lightly on his head and slid down his head. Then he felt a huge force strangle his neck and at the same time drag his whole body towards the north.
When Ash saw that the bandit had been trapped, she secretly rejoiced. There were so many ways to play and innovate in rope manipulation. Thank you for blessing me, Anser. Now, cut off his head...
The bone rope suddenly tightened, and when Ash pulled it down with his right hand, the bone rope tightened like a guillotine, and cut off the bandit's neck with a pop. His head circled from the sentry tower and fell into the soil with a dull thud.
"What are your names?
